```{=html}
<div class="watch-intro section-shell-narrow">
  <p class="status-badge in-development">In development</p>
  <p class="page-deck">New work on cities and climate appears in many places: academic journals, government reports, city networks, news coverage and public discussion. Current Conversations will bring some of those discussions together and show how they connect to the lab’s four questions.</p>
  <p>The feature is still being developed. When it launches, items will be found and summarised automatically. Appearing here will not mean that the lab endorses a source or believes that its findings apply to another city.</p>
  <p><strong>The live feed is not yet enabled.</strong></p>
  <div class="research-watch-disclosure" role="note" aria-label="Current Conversations development and non-endorsement disclosure">
    <p><strong>When Current Conversations launches, items will be collected, classified and summarised automatically. Inclusion will not indicate endorsement, evidential quality or applicability to a particular city.</strong></p>
    <p>Automated discovery can miss context or make mistakes. Readers will always be able to follow a link to the original source.</p>
  </div>
  <p>The feature will offer a selective view, not a systematic review, quality assessment, recommendation or complete map of discussion.</p>
  <p><a href="how-it-works.html">Read the planned methods, safeguards and limitations →</a></p>
</div>
```
